notes: Direct HTTP throughout, no WAF (confirms prior Home-Decor pass note: Shopify store rockettstgeorge-live.myshopify.com, no blocking). Enumerated all 336 live collections via /collections.json?limit=250 (2 pages) and scanned titles/handles for pet/dog/cat/puppy/kitten/animal/leash/collar/litter/crate/kennel/paw/vet plus a broader Tier-1-keyword pass (bowl/feed/walk/harness/carrier/scratch/chew/groom/treat/waste/litter/kennel/crate/lead/collar/toy/bed/blanket) to catch pet categories not literally titled 'pet'. Also checked the rendered mega-menu (homepage nav) for a 'Pets'-branded nav node: found only 'For Pets' under 'Gifts By Person' (a gift-guide/occasion facet of the Gifts hub, itself excluded per standing Gifts-hub exclusion) which 301-redirects to the homepage and whose /collections/pets/products.json returns 0 products -- i.e. dead/removed, not a real category. INCLUDED (genuine pet-care leaves, qty verified two ways -- products.json exhaustion, since collections.json 'products_count' is confirmed inflated on this store per prior pass -- cross-checked against the rendered 'You're viewing X of Y' / 'N Results' listing-header text, which matched exactly in both cases): Pet Beds & Blankets (2, both dog beds) and Collars & Leads (1, a dog lead). EXCLUDED: Pet Accessories collection (/collections/pet-accessories) -- live page renders 'Sorry, there are no products in this collection', 0 products per products.json, dropped as a zero-result category. Animal Magic (42 products) and Animal Lights (~20) -- inspected product list, confirmed these are animal-motif home decor for humans (French Bulldog teapot, animal salt/pepper shakers, gold elephant side table, peacock/swan/lion wall art and lamps, etc.), not products made for pets -- pet-themed/animal-themed decor, excluded per boundary rule. Bird Tables, Bird Baths & Feeders (8 products) -- garden/wild-bird feeding equipment, not care products for an owned/domestic pet, excluded as out of Pet Care scope (garden/outdoor accessory). No pet food/consumable or medical/veterinary categories found on this site.
